# Fixtures the native-vs-JVM comparison runs on every image build.
#
# The full sweep is 127 fixtures x up to 3 slots and belongs on a developer's
# machine; this subset is chosen to span the SURFACES on which the image can
# answer differently from the JVM, one fixture each, so that the gate a push
# can afford still covers every shape:
#
#   java-interop           Java PSI reached from Kotlin. The one that caught
#                          the JDK-discovery gap: 1 of 2 calls resolved
#                          natively against the JVM's 2.
#   java-signature-kotlin-types  Java fields and methods typed by Kotlin
#                          declarations: the cache shape that killed the image
#                          (Caffeine WIA/FWA, atom-tools#95) on every mixed
#                          Java/Kotlin repository while the JVM completed.
#   android-agp-namespace  Java + a manifest + endpoint substantiation: the
#                          only other fixture with .java sources, and the one
#                          that exercises the endpoint path over them.
#   latest-syntax          The widest spread of Kotlin syntax kinds, which is
#                          the PSI-element reflection surface — the thing an
#                          agent-derived metadata file under-covers.
#   dep-taint-through-lib  The deps tier: dependency lowering and the
#                          bytecode reader, over the committed helper jar.
#   multi-module-gradle    Project discovery and per-module classpaths.
#   ktor-app               Framework detection and endpoint extraction, which
#                          run off descriptors and service registrations.
#   crypto-algorithms      The crypto collector, which reads its own
#                          resource-backed model packs.
#   kosi-vulnerable-service  Taint: the deepest data-flow path in the tree.
#   spring-const-scoping-unresolved  Mapping paths written as templates,
#                          escapes and Java constants, read from PSI: the
#                          string-template entry types the resolved tier
#                          had never reflected on (atom-tools#95 review).
#   dsl-loop-scoping-unresolved  DSL routes over constants and loop lists
#                          with no framework jar: the scoped constant table
#                          reached from the KIR value folder.
#
# What this subset would have caught: the JDK gap (java-interop, on stats),
# and the JavaClassSupersImpl crash (android-agp-namespace or java-interop,
# on any comparison at all).
#
# What it would still miss: a divergence confined to a fixture outside the
# list, and anything the corpus shows that no fixture does. The full sweep
# stays the release check for that reason.
java-interop
java-signature-kotlin-types
android-agp-namespace
latest-syntax
dep-taint-through-lib
multi-module-gradle
ktor-app
crypto-algorithms
kosi-vulnerable-service
spring-const-scoping-unresolved
dsl-loop-scoping-unresolved
